words.example: The post-service procedure covers caring for the client after the service.

Remove the covers from the impellers and any other removable components

meaning.zh: 分解顽固膜层；专为硬水设计

evidence.quote: Chelating detergents break down stubborn films and help remove pedicure product residues.
Chelating soaps (CHE-layt-ing SOHPS), also known as chelating deter-gents, work to break down stubborn films
are specially formulated to work in areas with hard tap water.
disinfectants are products that destroy most bacteria (not including spores), fungi, and viruses on surfaces.
Disinfectants are not for use on human skin, hair, or nails.
